info.title: Pathfinder API
info.description: State-aware agentic trip planner. The frontend's only coupling is this contract (and the shared TripPlan JSON Schema in contracts/).

post.description: 409 when `focus` is sent without a plan; 422 when `focus` names a part not in the plan.

patch.description:
Edit one stop by hand (no AI): times, note, or move it to another trip day. 409 without a
plan or when the stop is locked; 422 for an unknown stop, end <= start, or a day outside the
trip.

delete.description:
Delete one stop by hand (no AI). 409 without a plan or when the stop is locked; 422 for an
unknown stop.

AgentName.title: AgentName
AgentName.description: The four pre-planning agents. Each owns one section of the TripPlan.

focus.description: The part of the current plan this message is about (plan workspace selection)

CheckName.title: CheckName
CheckName.description: The check-and-merge checks named in Appendix A: dates, budget, route, tickets.

ConstraintKind.title: ConstraintKind
ConstraintKind.description: Hard-constraint classes; also the stratification key for the 70/30 eval split.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: False when a priced section is unavailable

FocusKind.title: FocusKind
FocusKind.description: The plan parts a chat message can be scoped to (plan workspace selection).

GateResult.title: GateResult
GateResult.description:
Final routing outcome after the clarification gate. `route` is the path actually taken:
anything not accepted becomes `Route.UNCLEAR` (clarify and return the turn to the user).

PlanFocus.title: PlanFocus
PlanFocus.description: The one part of the current plan a chat message is about.

day.title: Day
day.description: Move the stop to this trip date

PlanItemPatch.title: PlanItemPatch
PlanItemPatch.description:
Body of PATCH /api/sessions/{session_id}/plan/items/{item_id}. Only the fields sent
change: `note: null` clears the note; times and day cannot be null. At least one field.

PreferenceProfile.title: PreferenceProfile
PreferenceProfile.description: What the user liked, kept as session memory and persisted by the background writer.

from_plan.title: From Plan
from_plan.description: True when the current TripPlan already held the fact

Route.title: Route
Route.description: The only outputs the System 1 router may produce (proposal: typed intent).

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.description: How fully specified the request is

affected_parts.title: Affected Parts
affected_parts.description: For 'modify': the parts System 1 names as changed

SectionStatus.title: SectionStatus
SectionStatus.description:
State of one agent-owned section of a plan.

`unavailable` means the source could not be used; the section is left empty rather than
filled from model knowledge. `stale` means the data is older than the configured limit and
is marked for refresh on the next modify turn.

ToolName.title: ToolName
ToolName.description: Tool families from Appendix A ("Tools the steps call").
